title: Sam Altman’s World Debuts ID Verification for AI Agents
script:
Sam Altman just brought official ID verification to AI agents.
His company, World, launched this feature on October 18, 2026.
Developers can now issue World ID credentials to their autonomous software.
This allows platforms to prove an agent is authorized by a human.
Previously, the World project relied on scanning human irises with the Orb.
Now, the new World ID suite lets bots carry cryptographic proof of identity.
World is opening this layer to third-party platforms starting today.
Would you trust a verified AI?
